title: Choose u
text: Let $$u=3x+3x^2+x^3$$, so $$du=\left(3+6x+3x^2\right) dx=3\left(1+2x+x^2\right) dx$$. The limits become $$u=7$$ and $$u=26$$.

title: Evaluate
text: $$\frac{1}{3}$$ times the integral of $$\frac{du}{u}$$ from $$7$$ to $$26$$ is $$\frac{1}{3} \left(\ln\left(26\right)-\ln\left(7\right)\right)=\frac{1}{3} \ln\left(\frac{26}{7}\right)$$.
